import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long M = 1000000007L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1;

        for (int _ = 0; _ < T; _++) {
            process(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static void process(Scanner scanner) {
        int P = scanner.nextInt();
        int K = scanner.nextInt();

        if (K == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(P, P - 1, M));
            return;
        }

        int[] k = new int[P];
        for (int x = 0; x < P; x++) {
            k[x] = (int)(((long)K * x) % P);
        }

        int[] f = new int[P];
        int[] c = new int[P];
        long ans = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
            if (f[i] != 0) continue;
            int cnt = 1;
            int u = i;
            f[u] = 1;
            while (f[k[u]] == 0) {
                u = k[u];
                f[u] = 1;
                cnt++;
            }
            c[cnt]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++) {
            if (c[i] != 0) {
                long cntVal = (long)i * c[i];
                if (i > 1) cntVal += 1;
                long power = powMod(cntVal, c[i], M);
                ans = (ans * power) % M;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * cur) % mod;
            }
            cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
